text:
erin: Hi @people-ops — I need to request a temporary remote accommodation for ~6 weeks starting next Monday due to a sensory overload flare. My doc recommended remote work + quieter schedule. Can someone advise next steps? I can DM the note privately.

maria: Thanks for sharing, Erin. We absolutely want to support you. Can you DM the medical note to me or @alex? Also please include the exact dates you expect and any specific schedule changes (standups, oncall, meetings).

erin: Will DM the note now. Tentative dates: 2025-10-06 to 2025-11-17. Preference: async standup updates and joining a single daily 30m chunk in the afternoon when it's quieter. Oncall: I can still respond but would prefer escalations routed to oncall pager, I can handle high-priority stuff.

alex: @maria @erin I created an ADA intake so we can document this and formalize accommodations. Erin, please fill the intake form when you get a sec: https://intranet.redwood/ada-intake (choose "temporary remote") — we'll handle manager guidance and any required paperwork.

people-ops-bot: Intake created — ID #4523 — created by alex — status: awaiting employee docs.

jamal: @maria re: interviews/hiring ops: we have a candidate loop Thurs 10/9 that Erin was scheduled to run. I can take the loop if Erin prefers to be remote. Can Erin share the panel notes or tasks that require onsite? I can cover onsite logistics.

maria: @jamal thanks — please cover the loop. Erin, if you can drop a short handoff note (bullets) in the interview doc that'd be ideal. To be explicit: this is an accommodation request; it's not a performance action. We'll set a monitoring/check-in cadence to make sure accommodations are working.

erin: I'll add a handoff in the interview doc and a short async checklist for the candidate debriefs. Also, please don't notify other team members without my consent — I'd prefer people-ops to handle communications.

alex: Understood. We'll only notify directly impacted folks (recruiter, backup interviewer) and mark the accommodation as private in the HR system. We'll also add a reminder for a 2-week check-in.

maria: Scheduling a 1:1 with People Ops Monday 11:00 to finalize. Also leadership: note for coverage planning and no change to performance expectations — just temporary process changes. :white_check_mark:

jamal: Confirmed on my side, I'll take the Thurs loop and sync with Erin for handoff. :thumbsup:

erin: Really appreciate everyone helping coordinate quickly.

alex: Quick checklist for tracking: 1) Erin submits doc to intake (done) 2) Manager acknowledges in HR system (maria) 3) Coverage assigned (jamal) 4) Check-in scheduled (alex) — I'll update ID #4523 when complete.

maria: Thanks @alex. Erin, if anything changes or you need more flexibility (shifted hours, quieter meeting options), ping me or @alex anytime.

erin: Will do. Thanks all.
